ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (approx. 92%) interspersed with localized high-intensity white punctate regions (approx. 8%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Punctate high-intensity white nodes distributed semi-randomly across both lobes; larger contiguous high-intensity patch at the superior-lateral margin of the right lobe; concentrated white speckling on the superior-lateral margin of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; estimated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees at the central vertex joining the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; prominent peaks at the medial section of the right lobe trailing edge; irregular jagged profile with multiple pixel-depth variations along the entire superior boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward concavity; lobes extend laterally and superiorly terminating in sharp, tapered acuminate tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of small circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black background) concentrated in the central and lateral regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal linear high-contrast mark on the lower-left lobe; vertical linear mark near the distal tip of the right lobe; multiple short horizontal linear disruptions on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular semi-circular excision (notch) on the trailing edge of the right lobe; multiple jagged indentation scars along the trailing edges of both lobes indicative of mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density 'star-field' punctate white speckling pattern distributed over a consistent dark pigmentation field.
